command: out=$(python3 greet.py); status=$?; printf 'captured stdout: [%s]\n' "$out"; printf 'raw bytes: '; python3 greet.py | od -c | head -3; printf 'exit status: %s\n' "$status"; if [ "$out" = "Hello, Agent!" ] && [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then echo "VERIFIED: exact match and exit 0"; else echo "VERIFICATION FAILED"; fi
